statement: Speed Buff in each kitchen table costs spices, and each level costs substantially more spices; it raises Cooking Speed per level.
Kitchen upgrade levels are not shared between tables; each table must be levelled individually.
Eggs is an early-game meal giving a decent bonus; spend a little time cooking it before moving on to later meals.
Corn Dogs is very similar to Eggs but gives a higher percentage of Meal Cooking Speed per level.
Cabbage is the single highest meal bonus to Meal Cooking Speed: 5% All Cooking Speed per 10 upgrade levels.
His example: 337 Cabbage levels give 2,640% more Cooking Speed.
Cabbage speed bonus jumps at each next tier of 10 levels even without upgrading Speed; multiplying 5% by 34x is a significant upgrade.
Meal bonuses must be levelled individually for each Kitchen as they are not shared.
Diamond Chef bubble gives more Meal and Fire Kitchen Speeds for every meal at level 11 or above (Diamond Blue plate).
Buy the Bargain upgrade in the Liquid Shop up to 90% off so Diamond Chef needs only 546 spices instead of 5.4K per level.
Long Island Tea vial (needs Sand Sharks) gives a decent multiplier to Meal Cooking Speed.
The vial's 60% is multiplied with other benefits so it goes further than it looks.
Cooked Meal Stamp at the bottom of the Skills tab gives 1% Meal Cooking Speed per level.
The Cooked Meal Stamp bonus can be doubled using the Lab.
The World 4 Laboratory has three Main Frame bonuses and four Jewels that give large Cooking Speed benefits.
Certified Stamp Book doubles all bonuses from Stamps.
My 1st Chemistry Set doubles all Alchemy Vial bonuses.
Spelunker Obol gives 50% higher effects from all active Jewels in the Mainframe.
Amethyst Rhinestone gives 2.25x more Meal Cooking Speed.
Amethyst bonus applies twice with all three Purple Jewels active at once for 4.5x Meal Cooking Speed.
Sapphire Pyramite gives three free levels to the lowest Kitchen Upgrades every 24 hours; adds up over time.
Free levels help especially higher-end Kitchens needing higher-level spices.
Emerald Pyramite gives 1.5x Meal Cooking Speed for every 25 total upgrades across all Kitchens.
Emerald Pyramite pairs well with Sapphire Pyramite because free levels increase its bonus.
He has about 80% more Meal Cooking Speed from the Emerald Pyramite.
Black Diamond Rhinestone gives 24% more bonuses from all meals; not shown in Dinner Table menu.
His Eggs have about 100% base Meal Cooking Speed and the jewel gives a free 24 on top.
Level each Dinner Menu meal to at least level 11 (Blue plate) to get Diamond Chef benefit; Purple plates are also good.
Meals on White or Gold or Bronze plates (below Blue) don't get Diamond Chef benefit.
His meals at level 11+ each give 18% more Cooking Speed.
As you unlock each meal take the time to level it to 11 for the benefit.
Up to 60 meals are available but that is very late game; gives a nice Cooking Speed bonus.
Ladles are gained by having a character AFK in the Kitchen area.
The character must be offline to gain ladles.
Don't use ladles unless a Blood Berserker is active with the Overflowing Ladle talent.
His Overflowing Ladle gives 57% more ladle bonus: an hour and a half of cooking time instead of an hour.
With enough talent points you can put up to 169 points into Overflowing Ladle.
Maxing talent points gives another 10% for a total of 67% more time per ladle used.
